rules.title: Compulsory registration of leases over 11 months
rules.gist: A lease of immovable property from year to year, or for a term exceeding one year, or reserving a yearly rent, must be registered.

rules.title: Effect of non-registration
rules.gist: An unregistered document required to be registered cannot be received as evidence of any transaction affecting the property or conferring the terms of the lease (limited exceptions for collateral purposes).

rules.title: Security deposit cap
rules.gist: Security deposit must not exceed 2 months' rent for residential premises and 6 months' rent for non-residential premises.

rules.title: Notice period for eviction and rent revision
rules.gist: Landlord must give at least 1 month's notice before eviction of a residential tenant, and 3 months' notice before revising rent.

rules.title: Penalty clauses limited to actual loss
rules.gist: Where a contract names a sum as penalty for breach, the aggrieved party can recover only reasonable compensation not exceeding the amount named, regardless of proof of actual loss.

rules.title: Agreements against public policy are void
rules.gist: Consideration or object of an agreement is unlawful if the court regards it as opposed to public policy; such agreements are void.

rules.title: Restraint of trade void
rules.gist: Every agreement by which anyone is restrained from exercising a lawful profession, trade or business is void to that extent.

rules.title: Notice period for termination of lease
rules.gist: In absence of contract to the contrary, a lease of immovable property for agricultural/manufacturing purposes is terminable on 6 months' notice, and for any other purpose (e.g. residential, month-to-month) on 15 days' notice.

rules.title: Rights and liabilities of lessor and lessee
rules.gist: Lessor must disclose material defects and allow quiet enjoyment; lessee may make repairs if lessor neglects them and deduct reasonable cost from rent.

rules.title: Grounds for eviction
rules.gist: A tenant can be evicted only on specified grounds: default in rent, subletting without consent, nuisance/misuse of premises, bona fide requirement of landlord, structural repairs needed, or similar listed grounds.

rules.title: Deposit of arrears stops eviction for default
rules.gist: In a suit for eviction on ground of rent default, if the tenant deposits the arrears and costs as directed by the court, the tenant cannot be evicted on that ground.

rules.title: Standard rent fixation
rules.gist: Either party may apply to the Rent Controlling Authority for fixation of standard/fair rent of the accommodation.

rules.title: Limits on rent increase
rules.gist: Rent can be increased only in the manner and to the extent permitted (e.g. for improvements/rise in taxes), not arbitrarily by the landlord.

rules.title: Landlord cannot cut essential services
rules.gist: Landlord cannot cut off or withhold water, electricity or other essential supply/service to the premises, even during a dispute, except in accordance with law.
rules.source: MP Accommodation Control Act 1961 (s.43-type provision) / Model Tenancy Act 2021 s.20

rules.title: Lock-in period limited to actual loss
rules.gist: A lock-in clause preventing early exit is enforceable only to the extent of the landlord's/tenant's actual demonstrable loss, not as an automatic penalty.
rules.source: Indian Contract Act 1872 s.74 (applied to lock-in clauses)

rules.title: Notice required before landlord's entry
rules.gist: Landlord must give at least 24 hours' notice before entering the premises for inspection/repairs, except in emergencies.

rules.title: Deposit forfeiture without accounting unenforceable
rules.gist: A clause allowing the landlord to forfeit the entire security deposit without accounting for actual dues/damage is not enforceable beyond the genuine loss shown.
rules.source: Indian Contract Act 1872 s.74; Model Tenancy Act 2021 s.11
